DARK TACTICAL CONSOLE

Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, tabular numerals, hairline rules, tight radii. Colour is reserved for data: amber marks the target AC and the leading turn, every build owns one hue, and turns inside a build separate by line style rather than a new hue.

EVERY NUMBER IS REAL

I ported src/lib/calculator.ts and ran six sample turns across AC 10-25, so the curves, deltas and source splits are your own maths — not invented sample data. The GW Master break-even points (AC 17.8 and AC 20.2) fall straight out of it.

Character names and ability spreads are the only invented part.

FOUR NEW ANALYSIS VIEWS

DPR-vs-AC curve, damage-source stack (dice / crit / ability / feat), hit and crit surfaced per turn, and Δ against a pinned baseline turn. The data model is untouched — all four are derived from what the store already holds, plus one new UI-only field: which turn is the baseline.

HANDOFF

Tokens are literal hex, ready to drop into a Tailwind v4 @theme block with daisyUI removed. The build palette and the damage-source ramp were both checked against the dark surface for colourblind separation and contrast rather than picked by eye.
